name: yt-mem-ai
description: YouTube AI: ingest, transcribe, embed, search, and summarize/highlight/digest videos. Bundles the yt + yt-manager skills and the yt-ai-mcp tool server.

interface.shortDescription: Ingest, search, and summarize/highlight YouTube videos.
interface.longDescription: Local-first YouTube pipeline: captions→whisper transcription, per-chunk embeddings in LanceDB, semantic search, and skills for summaries, highlights, digests, and cross-video reviews. Tools run via the yt-ai-mcp server; scenarios via the yt and yt-manager skills.
